name: Gruagachan
description: Hedge wizards descended from the Pictish priesthood of Gruagach, who use geas and curse magic and see themselves as enforcers of poetic justice. Most are unGifted and initiated, organized in collectives under Gifted masters.

name: Gruagach Magic Defenses
description: Form-specific Magic Defenses gruagachan receive for each Gruagach Art they possess, such as Magical Fortitude (Give) against Corpus effects and Strength of Form (Shape) against Corpus or Animal effects.

name: Gruagach Initiations
description: Initiation Scripts through which unGifted gruagachan gain their Arts, such as the Curse Initiation fulfilled by punishing a wrongdoer or the Shape Initiation tied to shapechangers.

name: Give
description: A gruagach Technique used to grant blessings, curses, shapes and visions to a target.

name: Take
description: A gruagach Technique used to remove or seize blessings, curses, shapes and visions.

name: Blessing
description: A gruagach Form that temporarily grants Virtues, Ability bonuses and Characteristic improvements; Take Blessing removes them. All Blessing spells use the Limit Duration.

name: Curse
description: A gruagach Form that inflicts Flaws, diseases and crippling effects; Take Curse removes curses and lingering magic.

name: Shape
description: A gruagach Form that alters the physical shape of the caster or others, including into animals, plants or objects.

name: Vision
description: A gruagach Form controlling perception of sight and sound, creating illusions, invisibility, sending the fetch to scout and granting glimpses of the future.

name: Geas (Condition) Duration
description: A gruagach Duration imposing a magical prohibition whose violation triggers a curse; its magnitude depends on whether the prohibition is sweeping, general or specific.

name: Limit (Condition) Duration
description: A gruagach Duration required for all Blessing and Curse spells, lasting until a condition that lifts the spell is fulfilled; easier-to-lift limits are cheaper.

name: Sweeping Prohibition
description: The broadest geas prohibition (+4 magnitudes, like Year Duration) or the easiest-to-lift limit on a blessing or curse (+1 magnitude).

name: General Prohibition
description: A prohibition roughly comparable to the Restriction Flaw, adding +2 magnitudes like Sun Duration.

name: Specific Prohibition
description: A narrow geas prohibition (+1 magnitude, like Diameter) or a hard-to-lift limit on blessings and curses (+4 magnitudes).

name: Poetic Justice
description: Rule that a geas or curse fitting the victim's past acts is harder to resist, modifying the victim's Stamina roll from -6 to +9; also the core ethic of the gruagachan.

name: Blessing of Urban Wisdom for the Rustic
description: GvBl 20 spell granting the target the Clear Thinker Virtue with a general Limit.

name: Blessing of the Swordsman's Expertise
description: GvBl 20 spell giving the target +2 to Single Weapon (or another Ability in variants) until a Limit is met.

name: Strike the Proud Low
description: TaBl 25 spell reducing one martial Ability of the victim to 0 until a Limit is fulfilled.

name: Make the Miser Generous
description: TaBl 30 spell eliminating a Major negotiation-related Virtue (or equivalent) from the victim until he behaves honestly.

name: Geas for the Narcissistic Maiden
description: GvCu 15 geas inflicting the Minor Flaw Disfigured on a victim who acts without humility, until she acts with humility.

name: Geas of Retribution for the Unthinking Slap
description: GvCu 25 geas that cripples one arm of the target if he breaks the geas.

name: Curse for the Spied Spy
description: GvCu 35 curse at Voice range that blinds the target until the condition is fulfilled or the wound heals.

name: Curse for the Unjust Justice
description: GvCu 25 curse with Blood target that afflicts a whole bloodline with the Flaw Judged Unfairly.

name: Question the Cursed
description: General-level TaCu spell revealing who cast a curse, its level, duration and Limit, or the terms of a geas.

name: Lift the Unfair Curse
description: General-level TaCu spell that removes a curse if the total meets double the curse's level (or its level if the caster cast it).

name: Borrow the Nose of the Hound
description: GvSh 3 spell turning the caster's nose into a hound's, granting +6 to smell-based Perception rolls.

name: Borrow the Wings of the Eagle
description: GvSh 10 spell turning the caster's arms into giant wings allowing flight as fast as a galloping horse.

name: Borrow the Eyes of the Cat
description: GvSh 5 spell known by Conall, cast at Voice Range.

name: Assume the Form of the Ancestors
description: GvSh 15 spell making the caster grow to giant size, +5 Size with Strength and Quickness adjustments.

name: Return the Lycanthrope to his Native Form
description: General-level TaSh spell that ends a transformation and returns the target to his native form.

name: Turn the Man into his Appropriate Form
description: TaSh 20 spell turning a human into a land animal mirroring his Personality Traits, e.g. a liar into a snake.

name: Skin of the Doppleganger
description: TaSh 20 spell letting the caster assume the perfect physical form of the victim, though not voice or mannerisms.

name: Grant a Glimpse of the Future
description: GvVs 30 spell granting the recipient hints and visions about a specific topic for a Moon.

name: Create the Hunter's Blind
description: GvVs 10 spell covering a small group with an illusion of boulders or bushes affecting sight only.

name: Eavesdrop with the Eyes
description: TaVs 10 spell letting the gruagach's fetch relay conversations of anyone within the caster's field of vision.

name: Track the Presence of Vis
description: TaVs 5 spell in which the gruagach's fetch locates nearby vis and vocalizes where it is.

name: Cloak for the Thief in the Night
description: TaVs 25 spell making a cloaked target silent and imageless until the cloak is removed.

name: Fetch
description: The gruagach's spirit companion, sent out by Vision spells to scout; visible to those with Second Sight. Trollsynir call it a fylgja.

name: Fylgja
description: The trollsynir name for their fetches.

name: Transformation
description: The gruagach equivalent of Wizard's Twilight, replacing normal Warping rules; accumulated Warping slowly turns a gruagach into a troll, complete at Warping Score 10.

name: Warping
description: Magical corruption from active supernatural effects and botches; Vision botches inflict double Warping for gruagachan.

name: Wizard's Twilight
description: The Hermetic consequence of Warping, to which gruagach Transformation and learned-magician intervention are equivalent.

name: Botch
description: Magical failures that for gruagachan may misdirect curses, give wrong forms, or yield false predictions, and expose the caster to Warping.

name: Troll
description: Monstrous man-devouring magical creatures; gruagachan and trollsynir who accumulate too much Warping become trolls.

name: External Soul
description: A soul kept outside the body; a gruagach dies if it is scratched, while kolduni can learn to have one that must be destroyed in a specific way.

name: Durable External Soul
description: Major Virtue kolduni must purchase so their External Soul can only be destroyed in a very specific manner.

name: Picti
description: Ancient tattooed people of Caledonia from whose priesthood the gruagachan descend; they ceased to exist as an independent tribe after the Battle of the False Sun.

name: Priesthood of Gruagach
description: Pictish priests of the god Gruagach who ensured crops and herds prospered and served as judges; ancestors of the gruagachan.

name: Gruagach
description: Pictish god of the sun, plants and animals, male equivalent of Cailleach, said to have taught his senior priest gruagach magic; perhaps originally a magical entity.

name: Cailleach
description: Pictish mother goddess appearing as an old crone with bear teeth or boar tusks, whose priestesses held great power.

name: Toranos
description: The Pictish thunder god.

name: Shoney
description: The Pictish god of fish.

name: Muireartach
description: The Pictish goddess of sea storms.

name: Fionn
description: Pictish god, protector of man and destroyer of giants and monsters.

name: Sluag
description: Pictish lord of the dead, holder of secret knowledge and creator of the written word.

name: Faerie Gruagachan
description: Knee-high long-haired faeries in gentleman's clothes to whom Scottish farmers pour milk; they curdle milk or dry cows if disrespected.

name: Pralix
description: Roman maga who came to the British Isles to destroy Damhan-Allaidh and defeated the gruagachan and their allies.

name: Damhan-Allaidh
description: Wizard who refused to bow to the Order of Hermes; the gruagachan rallied to his side against Pralix.

name: Anglo-Saxon rune wizards
description: Group of rune wizards who fought alongside Damhan-Allaidh and the gruagachan against Pralix.

name: Battle of the False Sun
description: Monumental battle in which Pralix's army defeated Damhan-Allaidh's allies; a spell erased the Pictish language from nearly everyone's memory.

name: Schism War
description: Conflict in which House Diedne was expelled and hunted; the gruagachan harried the Diedne and seized their auras and vis sites.

name: House Diedne
description: Druidic House formed in 767, longtime rivals of the Pictish priests, cursed by the gruagachan and later expelled from the Order.

name: House Merinita
description: Hermetic House whose Until, While, Not and If (Condition) Durations resemble the gruagach Geas and Limit Durations.

name: House Bjornaer
description: Hermetic House whose magi transform into their Heartbeast.

name: House Ex Miscellanea
description: Hermetic House into which integration of Cailleach Magic might bring dozens of gruagachan.

name: House Bonisagus
description: Hermetic House of theorists; a member achieving the Improved Voice Range breakthrough would be a likely candidate for Primus.

name: Bonisagus
description: Founder of Hermetic theory, whose theory requires Arcane Connections for unsensed targets.

name: Order of Hermes
description: The organization of Hermetic magi, with which gruagachan have an uneasy détente; gruagachan call its members Romans.

name: Hermetic Gruagachan
description: Gruagachan nominally members of the Order of Hermes, taking the Hedge Wizard Flaw and Arcane Lore Virtue.

name: Gruagach Collective
description: The typical gruagach organization of one to three Gifted gruagachan with unGifted students, which competes with others for vis and apprentices.

name: Friendly Gruagach Collective
description: Major Covenant Boon in which the covenant controls a nearby gruagach collective that trades vis and gives aid.

name: Hostile Gruagach Collective
description: Major Covenant Hook in which a nearby gruagach collective spreads rumors and harvests the covenant's vis.

name: Gruagach Ally
description: Minor Covenant Boon: a single gruagach living near the covenant who assists the magi.

name: Gruagach Resident
description: Minor Covenant Hook: one or more gruagachan live in the covenant, likely drawing a Quaesitor's visit.

name: Hedge Tradition
description: Covenant Boon of which Friendly Gruagach Collective is a variant.

name: Quaesitor
description: Hermetic investigator who may visit a covenant harboring gruagachan.

name: Domhnall the Gruagach Master
description: Gifted gruagach master from a Scottish highland village, a large cudgel-wielding man who fought the English and seeks to rebuild a collective.

name: Conall the Gruagach
description: UnGifted gruagach and hunter, blamed for every mishap, who shapeshifts into a bear and studies under Domhnall.

name: Trollsynir
description: Children or grandchildren of Jotnar who practice Trollskap, a magic like the gruagachan's, mostly in Iceland and northern lands.

name: Trollskap
description: The magic of the trollsynir, performed like gruagach magic but using the Jotnar language and no tattoo magic.

name: Etin Bride
description: A female Jotun who has taken a human husband and teaches Trollskap to her descendants.

name: Jotnar
description: Norse race of giants spawned by Ymir; ancestors and relatives of the trollsynir.

name: Ymir
description: The primordial Norse giant formed from ice, killed by Odin and his brothers to create the world of men.

name: Odin
description: Norse god who with his brothers killed Ymir.

name: Kolduni
description: Mercenary pagan wizards of the Novgorod Tribunal wilderness whose magic resembles gruagach magic and draws on faeries and pagan gods.

name: Koldovali
description: The kolduni's name for their oral magic, very similar to gruagach magic, in which water plays an important role.

name: Kara
description: The kolduni term for a geas or curse.

name: Koshchey the Deathless
description: Powerful koldun whose soul is hidden in an egg in a duck in a hare in a chest under an oak on an island in a regio.

name: Arcane Connection Range
description: Range available to kolduni (+4 magnitudes) requiring the Arcane Connection to be submerged in water.

name: Arcane Connection
description: A link needed under Hermetic theory to cast spells on unsensed targets.

name: Integration
description: Hermetic research incorporating aspects of hedge magic into Hermetic theory, measured in Breakthrough Points.

name: Hermetic Breakthrough
description: A research achievement expanding Hermetic theory, such as integrating Improved Voice Range.

name: Cailleach Magic
description: Gruagach Virtue allowing Spontaneous Magic like Diedne Magic; integrated as a teachable Virtue with the Hedge Wizard Flaw instead of Dark Secret.

name: Diedne Magic
description: Hermetic Virtue for enhanced spontaneous casting, to which Cailleach Magic is equivalent.

name: Flexible Formulaic Magic
description: Virtue letting a caster vary a Formulaic spell's parameters; integration could make it a Spell Mastery ability or a teachable Ability.

name: Spell Mastery
description: Hermetic Ability which could gain a Flexible Formulaic Magic option through integration.

name: Improved Voice Range
description: Gruagach ability to curse anyone within earshot without sensing them; integration would be a major breakthrough, suggested at +3 magnitudes.

name: Spontaneous Magic
description: Unprepared spellcasting, which gruagachan with Cailleach Magic cast with ease.

name: Formulaic Magic
description: Learned spells; gruagachan may alter Range, Target or Duration of their formulaic spells by 10 levels.

name: Parma Magica
description: Hermetic magical defense that attracts some gruagachan to join the Order.

name: Code of Hermes
description: The Order's law; Hermetic gruagachan need at least 1 in it.

name: Hermetic Oath
description: Oath sworn to join the Order, which some gruagachan take to learn Parma Magica.

name: The Gift
description: Innate magical talent whose social effects limit the size of gruagach and trollsynir groups; learned magician masters open a student's Gift in a season-long ritual.

name: Gentle Gift
description: Major Hermetic Virtue that trollsdottirs often possess; Domhnall has it.

name: Dominion
description: The Divine realm whose aura interferes with gruagach and learned-magician magic.

name: Infernal
description: Realm whose hostile auras learned magicians mitigate through Entreat the Powers.

name: Faerie
description: Realm with which kolduni interact; warped kolduni are eventually taken to it.

name: Magic
description: Realm of magic; trollsynir favor powerful Magic auras and herbalists use plants from Magic auras.

name: Aura
description: Realm influence at a location, affecting transformation rolls and magic; gruagachan seized Diedne auras.

name: Regio
description: Supernatural layered area; trollsynir favor them and Koshchey's soul is hidden in one.

name: Vis
description: Raw magical power that gruagachan and magi compete over; mythic alchemists can extract it.

name: Magic Resistance
description: Resistance that gruagach and learned-magician magic must overcome before the victim resists further.

name: Tattoo Magic
description: Gruagach tattoo-based magic not practiced by trollsynir or kolduni.

name: Corpus
description: Hermetic Form against whose effects several gruagach Magic Defenses apply.

name: Mentem
description: Hermetic Form; gruagachan get defenses against its effects and compete over Mentem vis.

name: Animal
description: Hermetic Form, defended against by Strength of Form.

name: Imaginem
description: Hermetic Form of images; Vision magic is governed by Imaginem guidelines.

name: Ignem
description: Hermetic Form of fire, used as an example of an Art in poetic justice.

name: Perdo
description: Hermetic Technique; Perdo Vim spells can dispel gruagach curses.

name: Vim
description: Hermetic Form of magic; Perdo Vim dispels curses and Vim vis is used by mythic alchemists.

name: Creo
description: Hermetic Technique whose Imaginem guidelines govern Give Vision.

name: Rego
description: Hermetic Technique whose Imaginem guidelines govern Give Vision.

name: Intellego
description: Hermetic Technique whose Imaginem guidelines govern Take Vision.

name: Terram
description: Hermetic Form; Terram vis may be used for Lapis Maior.

name: Loch Leglean Tribunal
description: Tribunal where gruagachan are especially suitable characters.

name: Stonehenge Tribunal
description: Tribunal where gruagachan are suitable characters.

name: Hibernian Tribunal
description: Tribunal where gruagachan are suitable characters.

name: Novgorod Tribunal
description: Tribunal whose wild areas are home to the kolduni and pagan worship, and whose northern reaches hold trollsynir.

name: Caledonia
description: Roman name for the land north of Britannia, modern Scotland, homeland of the Picti.

name: Scottish Highlands
description: Region where gruagachan dwell; Domhnall and Conall come from a highland village.

name: Britannia
description: Roman Britain, south of Caledonia; Pralix came to the British Isles to fight Damhan-Allaidh.

name: Iceland
description: Where trollsynir are most common.

name: Ultima Thule
description: Northern land where trollsynir also live.

name: Bologna
description: One of the largest cities of western Mythic Europe, home to a great university and the Mathematici.

name: University of Bologna
description: Great university drawing thousands of students, among whom the secret society of Mathematici grew.

name: Mythic Europe
description: The Ars Magica setting, across which learned magicians and other traditions are found.

name: Church
description: Christian Church whose teachings on magic gruagachan fear; most Picti converted to Christianity.

name: Old Ways
description: Pagan religion some unGifted gruagachan follow after abandoning the Church.

name: Learned Magicians
description: Scholarly hedge magicians who cast verbal charms and create amulets and chartae, calling on powers of the four Realms.

name: Mathematici of Bologna
description: Secret society of learned magicians among the University of Bologna's students and scholars, including clergy and men of letters.

name: Lore of the Mathematici
description: (Organization) Lore of the Bologna learned-magician tradition, covering its charms, members, history and Initiation rites.

name: Mathematicus of Bologna
description: Free Social Status marking membership in the Mathematici tradition; requires a Hedge Technique and Form and a mundane Social Status.

name: Tueor
description: Learned-magician Technique, a Difficult Art advancing as an Ability, granted by its Virtue.

name: Succurro
description: Learned-magician Technique; the Succurro Magicam Lab Total is used for Opening The Gift and vis extraction.

name: Vulnero
description: Learned-magician Technique, a Difficult Art advancing as an Ability.

name: Fortunam
description: Learned-magician Form; Fortunam charms influence luck and actions of others.

name: Magicam
description: Learned-magician Form granted by the Magicam Virtue.

name: Salutem
description: Learned-magician Form granted by the Salutem Virtue.

name: Verbal Charms
description: Quick, short-lived, least powerful learned-magician magic, which can violate the Arcane Connection limit.

name: Chartae
description: Simple one-shot learned-magician magic devices roughly equal in strength to Formulaic spells.

name: Amulets
description: More powerful learned-magician devices taking a season to produce, with longer-lasting effects.

name: Intervention
description: The learned-magician equivalent of Twilight, normally resisted on a double botch.

name: Mitigation of Realm Interaction Effects
description: Learned-magician rules for reducing penalties from Divine or Infernal auras via Entreat the Powers.

name: Entreat the Powers
description: Major Supernatural Virtue letting a learned magician minimize negative effects of Divine or Infernal auras on magic.

name: Entreat the (Realm) Powers
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue to call on one chosen realm's powers to offset hostile aura penalties.

name: Mythic Alchemy
description: Major Supernatural Virtue and Ability allowing magical transmutation of substances, preparing superior craft materials and extracting vis.

name: Lapis Maior
description: Level 15 Substantial alchemical reagent, a waxy red stone that transmutes up to 50 cubic inches of lead into gold.

name: Cordovan Cuirbolli
description: Level 5 Minor alchemical reagent turning hides into superior boiled leather, reducing Craft Ease Factors by 2.

name: Mythic Herbalism
description: Major Supernatural Virtue and Ability to brew healing unguents, poisons and potions granting physical bonuses.

name: Strong Amulet Magic
description: Major Supernatural Virtue giving +10 to Lab Totals for creating chartae and amulets.

name: Strong Verbal Charms
description: Major Supernatural Virtue improving the level of verbal charms and charms cast from texts.

name: Natural Magician
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue using natural magic principles to add Philosophiae against negative realm interaction on season-long activities.

name: Skilled Master
description: Minor General Virtue granting an extra 50 experience points for Arts, Abilities and charms.

name: Charm Magician
description: Major Supernatural Flaw: the learned magician may not create amulets, only chartae.

name: Intervention Prone
description: Major Supernatural Flaw: the magician must resist intervention on a single botch rather than a double botch.

name: Laboratory Magician
description: Major Supernatural Flaw: the character may cast charms only with the aid of a text.

name: Weak Verbal Charms
description: Major Supernatural Flaw: casting total plus die for charms is always divided by five.

name: Incompatible Hedge Arts
description: Minor Supernatural Flaw preventing use of one Technique-Form combination.

name: No Chartae Making
description: Minor Supernatural Flaw: the character cannot create chartae.

name: No Text Casting
description: Minor Supernatural Flaw: the character cannot cast charms from texts.

name: Poorly Trained Magician
description: Minor Supernatural Flaw reducing experience points for Arts and charms by 50.

name: Weak Amulets
description: Minor Supernatural Flaw subtracting five from Lab Totals for amulets.

name: Weak Chartae
description: Minor Supernatural Flaw subtracting five from Lab Totals for chartae.

name: Magister in Artibus
description: Social Status of a university master of arts, suitable for a mathematicus.

name: Gruagach
description: Social Status Virtues of the gruagach tradition taken by Domhnall (Gruagach Master) and Conall.

name: Wise One
description: Social Status kolduni may possess.

name: Outcast
description: Social Status kolduni may possess.

name: Peasant
description: Social Status held by Conall.

name: Arcane Lore
description: Virtue giving 50 experience points in Arcane Abilities, recommended for Hermetic gruagachan.

name: Hedge Wizard
description: Flaw taken by nominal Hermetic gruagachan and suffered by those with Cailleach Magic.

name: Dark Secret
description: Story Flaw carried by Diedne Magic and possessed by Conall.

name: Clear Thinker
description: Minor Virtue granted by Blessing of Urban Wisdom for the Rustic and suitable for learned magicians.

name: Toughness
description: Virtue used as an example for Give Blessing prohibitions and a troll Virtue.

name: Affinity with Ability
description: Virtue possessed by the example merchant (Bargain).

name: Premonitions
description: Virtue that Give Vision can grant, restricted to one type of danger; appropriate for kolduni.

name: Visions
description: Flaw Give Vision can grant, restricted to a single topic; appropriate for kolduni.

name: Second Sight
description: Virtue letting a character see a gruagach's fetch; appropriate for kolduni.

name: Giant Blood
description: Required Virtue for trollsynir and a possible troll Virtue.

name: Large
description: Troll-appropriate Virtue possessed by Domhnall.

name: Sharp Ears
description: Troll Virtue a transforming gruagach may gain.

name: Reserves of Strength
description: Troll Virtue a transforming gruagach may gain.

name: Improved Characteristics
description: Virtue possessed by Domhnall.

name: Warrior
description: Virtue possessed by Domhnall and Conall.

name: Shapeshifter
description: Virtue and Supernatural Ability Conall uses to become a bear.

name: Major Magical Focus
description: Hermetic Virtue with a gruagach equivalent gained through good Transformation.

name: Minor Magical Focus
description: Hermetic Virtue; Domhnall's is self-transformation.

name: Secondary Insight
description: Major Hermetic Virtue available to gruagachan and learned magicians.

name: Affinity with Art
description: Minor Hermetic Virtue available to gruagachan and learned magicians.

name: Cautious Sorcerer
description: Minor Hermetic Virtue available to gruagachan and learned magicians.

name: Deft Form
description: Minor Hermetic Virtue available to gruagachan and learned magicians.

name: Fast Caster
description: Minor Hermetic Virtue available to gruagachan and learned magicians.

name: Free Study
description: Virtue with a gruagach equivalent gained through Transformation.

name: Harnessed Magic
description: Minor Hermetic Virtue available to gruagachan and learned magicians.

name: Magical Memory
description: Minor Hermetic Virtue available to gruagachan and learned magicians.

name: Personal Vis Source
description: Minor Hermetic Virtue available to gruagachan and learned magicians.

name: Puissant Art
description: Minor Hermetic Virtue available to gruagachan and learned magicians.

name: Side Effect
description: Minor Hermetic Virtue available to gruagachan and learned magicians.

name: Special Circumstances
description: Minor Hermetic Virtue available to gruagachan and learned magicians.

name: Subtle Magic
description: Minor Hermetic Virtue available to gruagachan and learned magicians.

name: Adept Laboratory Student
description: Minor Hermetic Virtue available to learned magicians.

name: Enduring Magic
description: Minor Hermetic Virtue available to learned magicians.

name: Inventive Genius
description: Minor Hermetic Virtue available to learned magicians.

name: Quiet Magic
description: Minor Hermetic Virtue available to learned magicians.

name: Ways of the (Land)
description: Virtue trollsynir often possess.

name: Wilderness Sense
description: Virtue trollsynir often possess.

name: Faerie Blood
description: Virtue appropriate for kolduni.

name: Student of Faerie Realm
description: Virtue appropriate for kolduni.

name: Faerie Friend
description: Virtue appropriate for kolduni.

name: Educated
description: Virtue suitable for learned magicians but not trollsynir.

name: Temporal Influence
description: Virtue common among learned magicians, inappropriate for trollsynir.

name: Apt Student
description: Virtue appropriate for learned magicians.

name: Good Teacher
description: Virtue appropriate for learned magicians.

name: Privileged Upbringing
description: Virtue appropriate for learned magicians.

name: Social Contacts
description: Virtue common among learned magicians.

name: Well-Traveled
description: Virtue common among learned magicians.

name: Wealthy
description: Virtue affecting how much freedom a mathematicus has to study.

name: Poor
description: Flaw affecting how much freedom a mathematicus has to study.

name: Disfigured
description: Minor Flaw inflicted by Geas for the Narcissistic Maiden; also a troll Flaw (Blue Skin).

name: Judged Unfairly
description: Minor Flaw inflicted on a bloodline by Curse for the Unjust Justice; possessed by Conall.

name: Mute
description: Flaw used as an example of a Give Curse effect.

name: Restriction
description: Flaw used as a guideline for geas prohibitions; Conall cannot use magic while bald.

name: Noncombatant
description: Minor Personality Flaw example guiding sweeping prohibitions for a grog.

name: Temperate
description: Minor Personality Flaw example guiding general prohibitions.

name: Social Handicap
description: Flaw suffered while a minor Give Shape transformation is in effect.

name: Envious
description: Flaw possessed by Domhnall.

name: Waster of Vis
description: Flaw possessed by Domhnall.

name: Careless Sorcerer
description: Minor Hermetic Flaw possessed by Domhnall and available to learned magicians.

name: Close Family Ties
description: Flaw appropriate for gruagachan, trollsynir and learned magicians.

name: Pagan
description: Flaw possessed by Domhnall and appropriate for trollsynir.

name: Mentor
description: Flaw possessed by Conall.

name: No Magical Defenses
description: Flaw possessed by Conall.

name: Unimaginative Learner
description: Flaw possessed by Conall.

name: Weak Tattoo Magic
description: Flaw possessed by Conall.

name: No Tattoo Magic
description: Flaw required of trollsynir and kolduni, who do not practice gruagach tattoo magic.

name: Blatant Gift
description: Major Hermetic Flaw with a gruagach equivalent; available to learned magicians.

name: Deficient Technique
description: Major Hermetic Flaw with gruagach and learned-magician equivalents.

name: Necessary Condition
description: Major Hermetic Flaw with gruagach and learned-magician equivalents.

name: Painful Magic
description: Major Hermetic Flaw with gruagach and learned-magician equivalents.

name: Rigid Magic
description: Major Hermetic Flaw with gruagach and learned-magician equivalents.

name: Short-Ranged Magic
description: Major Hermetic Flaw available to learned magicians.

name: Deficient Form
description: Minor Hermetic Flaw with gruagach and learned-magician equivalents.

name: Deleterious Circumstances
description: Minor Hermetic Flaw with gruagach and learned-magician equivalents.

name: Disorientating Magic
description: Minor Hermetic Flaw with gruagach and learned-magician equivalents.

name: Incompatible Arts
description: Hermetic Flaw with a gruagach equivalent.

name: Warped Magic
description: Minor Hermetic Flaw with gruagach and learned-magician equivalents.

name: Weak Magic
description: Minor Hermetic Flaw with gruagach and learned-magician equivalents.
